response.sql: WITH telescope_avg AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus, AVG(s.pulsepersec) AS pulse_avg FROM signals AS s JOIN telescopes AS t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.telescregistry, t.equipstatus), status_avg AS (SELECT equipstatus, AVG(pulse_avg) AS pulse_avg FROM telescope_avg GROUP BY equipstatus), first_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM status_avg), above_first AS (SELECT sa.equipstatus, sa.pulse_avg, fm.mean_avg AS first_mean FROM status_avg AS sa CROSS JOIN first_mean AS fm WHERE sa.pulse_avg > fm.mean_avg), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(pulse_avg) AS mean_avg FROM above_first) SELECT AVG(af.pulse_avg) AS average_pulse_rate, AVG(af.pulse_avg - af.first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(af.pulse_avg - sm.mean_avg) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM above_first AS af CROSS JOIN second_mean AS sm WHERE af.pulse_avg > sm.mean_avg;

assumptions.assumption: A missing equipment status is excluded because it does not identify a status.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat a missing equipment status as its own status group.
